typology.definition: A state's capacity to develop, run and govern AI on infrastructure, data and models it controls, rather than renting them from foreign providers. Definitions are contested: 'hard' sovereignty means self-sufficiency across the stack; 'soft' sovereignty means control over the layers that matter for a given use case.

sources.value: McKinsey: four components - territorial, operational, technological, legal
CSET: five-layer stack - energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications - plus talent, capital, research, governance, security

typology.definition: Domestic data centres and GPU clusters under national legal control, funded by budgets, state banks or sovereign-wealth vehicles.
typology.caveat: Hosting is not ownership: Malaysia hosts ~9% of Epoch-tracked frontier compute, largely for foreign tenants; France's 'sovereign' Campus AI is 70% owned by Abu Dhabi's MGX.

typology.definition: Foundation models pre-trained from random initialisation by a national lab or champion.

typology.term: Sovereign models - adapted (continued pre-training / fine-tune of foreign open weights)
typology.definition: A national model built on a foreign open-weight base (Llama, Gemma, Qwen, Mistral, Nemotron) with local data.

share.value: 56% of sovereign LLMs; Llama 38%, Qwen 20%, Mistral 19% of adapted

typology.caveat: Inherits the base model's licence, training-data and alignment choices; an AIES paper calls fine-tune-only sovereignty 'sovereignty theater'. Korea disqualified Naver for unmodified Qwen encoder weights (Jan 2026). Supply risk: CNAS (26 Oct 2026) warns top open-weight releases may dry up as Beijing drafts export controls covering model weights (MOFCOM/MOST draft 16 Oct 2026, comments to 15 Nov 2026).

typology.definition: Foreign proprietary or open models run in-country under local data residency, often via 'sovereign cloud' offers.
examples: Japan's 'Gennai' government AI (OpenAI-powered, now A/B-testing domestic LLMs)
SoftBank Cloud PF Type A on Oracle Alloy
typology.caveat: Stanford HAI (Jul 2026 brief): big-tech sovereignty offerings may reconfigure rather than remove dependency.

typology.definition: Legal and practical control over national training corpora and the data pipeline (licensed national-library, news and administrative text).
examples: GPT-NL licensed news + KB national library

typology.definition: Public money behind the stack: budgets/appropriations, equity funds, sovereign-wealth vehicles, and mobilisation headlines - four categories that must never be summed.
Markets where foreign assistants are blocked or restricted, so domestic models dominate regardless of policy intent.
examples: Russia (sanctions): domestic share depends on measurement method

typology.term: Popularity metrics (and why they cannot be compared)
typology.definition: Hugging Face downloads (developer pulls, inflated by CI/mirrors), derivatives (fine-tunes on a base), app MAU/WAU (consumer reach; panels disagree), web-traffic share, Statcounter referral share (clicks from chatbots to websites), OpenRouter token share (one developer aggregator), leaderboard rank (capability, not use).
typology.caveat: Report each metric with its scope; never mix WAU with MAU or HF-only with all-channel downloads.

stop_quoting.claim: Perplexity holds about 48% of Russia's AI-chatbot market.
stop_quoting.fact: No source found supports it. Statcounter's Russia AI-chatbot table for June 2026 shows ChatGPT at 48.68% and Perplexity at 31.5% (a referral-traffic measure; on mobile Perplexity is 7.55%). Web-traffic data for 2025 put ChatGPT near 40% and DeepSeek at 27.8%.

stop_quoting.claim: South Korea runs on Naver's HyperCLOVA X / HyperCLOVA X is Korea's most-used AI model.
stop_quoting.fact: Naver closed its standalone Clova X chatbot in April 2026, and Korea's ministry dropped Naver Cloud from the national foundation-model project on 15 January 2026. ChatGPT's Korean app had 18.76 million monthly users in October 2026 (Mobile Index), about 91% of AI-app users. HyperCLOVA X's reach is through Naver search: AI Briefing ~30 million monthly users (May 2026).
stop_quoting.source: Mobile Index via Hankyung; Naver; Korea Herald

stop_quoting.fact: No evidence of government adoption was found. Japan's Digital Agency began trialling three domestic LLMs on its 'Gennai' platform in July 2026: NTT's tsuzumi 2, Fujitsu's Takane 32B and PFN's PLaMo 2.0 Prime.

stop_quoting.claim: India is OpenAI's second-largest ChatGPT market.
stop_quoting.fact: True in February 2026 (100 million weekly users). On 3 November 2026 OpenAI's India managing director said India had become ChatGPT's largest market by weekly active users, with the user base doubling since January.
34,000+ was the May-June 2025 count. 38,231 GPUs were onboarded by 25 March 2026 (Lok Sabha), and the IT minister announced 20,000 more in February 2026; the end-2026 target is 100,000.

stop_quoting.claim: Falcon models have been downloaded 45 million times.
stop_quoting.fact: TII has since reported 55 million+ downloads across the Falcon ecosystem (2025); its Q1 2024 figure was 43 million.

stop_quoting.claim: Mistral AI is valued at $14 billion.
stop_quoting.fact: That was the September 2025 Series C (EUR 11.7B). Mistral's EUR 3 billion Series D on 8 September 2026 valued it at more than EUR 21 billion post-money (~US$24B).

stop_quoting.claim: Le Chat is Mistral's consumer assistant.
stop_quoting.fact: Mistral renamed Le Chat to Vibe on 28 May 2026; quote the new name with 'formerly Le Chat'.

stop_quoting.claim: Aleph Alpha is Germany's independent sovereign AI champion.
stop_quoting.fact: Canada's Cohere agreed to acquire Aleph Alpha (announced 24 April 2026); the combined group keeps the Cohere name and Aleph Alpha shareholders hold about 10%.

stop_quoting.claim: Stargate UAE is live / went live in 2026.
stop_quoting.fact: Epoch AI's satellite-based tracking shows 0 MW operational at Stargate UAE as of November 2026, with the first two 100 MW buildings projected for December 2026.

stop_quoting.claim: Saudi Arabia's HUMAIN is deploying 600,000 Nvidia GPUs.
stop_quoting.fact: 600,000 is an 'up to' ceiling over three years across Saudi Arabia and the US. The deal HUMAIN signed in October 2026 covers up to 84 MW and about 27,000 GPUs through 2027, starting with ~6,000 B300s in Q4 2026.

stop_quoting.claim: Most national 'sovereign' models are home-grown from scratch.
stop_quoting.fact: Counterpoint's H1 2026 index found 56% of sovereign LLMs are adapted from foreign bases (Llama 38%, Qwen 20%, Mistral 19% of those). CNAS puts from-scratch models at about 40% of tracked model projects (Aug 2026).

stop_quoting.claim: Chinese models take 61% of OpenRouter tokens.
stop_quoting.fact: 61% is the Chinese share among the top-10 models only, Feb-Mar 2026. Platform-wide snapshots in April 2026 showed ~51%, and Chinese models' share of US enterprise traffic was 30-46% weekly.

stop_quoting.claim: Doubao has 382 million users; Qwen's app 167 million.
stop_quoting.fact: Those are May-June 2026 readings. QuestMobile's September 2026 figures: Doubao 419.08 million MAU, Qwen app 158.17 million (down), DeepSeek 122.65 million.

stop_quoting.claim: The EU is building four AI gigafactories with EUR 20 billion.
stop_quoting.fact: No site has been chosen. The formal EuroHPC call for up to seven gigafactories closed on 12 November 2026, with awards expected in early 2027; public funding reported at EUR 10 billion plus ~EUR 20 billion hoped-for private money.
Sources disagree on whether 600,000 refers to users or to requests; ISSAI reports 140,000+ downloads. Quote neither as 'users' without the caveat.
